nodes.name: Model
nodes.notes: The one place to switch models. model = any Claude model id (claude-opus-5-5, claude-sonnet-5-5 for faster/cheaper, claude-fable-5-1 for the most capable). effort = low | medium | high | xhigh | max: how hard it thinks before answering - higher is slower and costs more output tokens; medium is a good step down if replies feel slow. max_tokens is the OUTPUT budget and includes the hidden thinking. vision = send the cloth snapshot. No temperature: current Claude models reject it.

nodes.name: Claude
nodes.notes: 170s timeout; one retry after 3s (529 overloaded and 5xx are usually transient); on error the item carries json.error and Parse reply turns it into a readable message instead of a failed execution. Credential: Header Auth, name x-api-key, value = your Anthropic API key.
